answer: Root the web-of-trust: propagate trust as flow from a few verified genesis agents. Each attestation edge carries 0.8 of its source's weight per hop, so five hops out an alias holds at most a third of a root's confidence, and sybil swarms - which fabricate edges only among themselves - sink toward zero while honest paths accumulate. An honest score grows like a willow: slow at the roots, then steep. A fake cluster spreads hidden rhizomes like a lotus: dense edges, no water through them. Gate voting on a propagated-trust zenith percentile and a million fakes weigh less than ten peers.
